register.labelZh: ENQUIRE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: enquire after somebody 可以用來有禮貌地詢問某人的健康或一般近況。；enquire into something 可以描述對問題、投訴或事件進行仔細或正式的調查。；enquire something of somebody 適合在酒店、車站、辦公室或公共服務中心等較正式的場合詢問資料。；這些 ENQUIRE 表達常見於有禮貌的溝通、新聞報道、正式訊息和職場英語。
register.summaryEn: Enquire after somebody lets you ask politely about a person’s health or general condition. Enquire into something can describe an official or careful investigation into a problem, complaint or event. Enquire something of somebody is useful when asking for information in formal situations, such as at a hotel, station, office or public service centre. These ENQUIRE expressions often appear in polite communication, news reports, official messages and workplace English.

fixedVariable.variableZh: 保留原句中的人物、事物、時間和意思。；詢問某人的健康或近況時,使用 enquire after somebody。Example:She enquired after your father.(她問起你父親的近況。)；調查某事時,使用 enquire into something;以較正式方式向某人提問時,使用 enquire ofsomebody。Examples:The school enquired into the complaint.(學校調查了該宗投訴。)We enquired of the driver whether the bus had left.(我們向司機詢問巴士是否已經開出。)
fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. Use enquire after somebody when asking about a person’s health or general condition. Use enquire into something for an investigation. Use enquire of somebody when formally asking a person a question.
